name: BUSIS (Breast Ultrasound Image Segmentation)
description: A dataset and benchmark suite for evaluating breast ultrasound image segmentation algorithms.
reputation: Moderately used within the medical imaging community for benchmarking breast ultrasound segmentation methods, especially in ultrasound-focused research.
notes: Non-LLM vision/medical benchmark; datasets can be relatively small with annotation variability, class imbalance, and high ultrasound noise—results are sensitive to preprocessing and annotation standards.
